notes: Implemented Phase 2 of Change Requests Implementation Plan (CR-03, CR-07, CR-09). CR-03: Fixed background image opacity rendering bug — renderImage() now pre-fills canvas with configured background color/gradient before drawing semi-transparent image, preventing white show-through. Added 7 tests in Section 1.5 of BackgroundRendererTest.html covering solid color behind image, gradient behind image, 100%/0% opacity edge cases, alpha state restoration, default color fallback, and null image handling. CR-07: Added export format selector (JPEG/PNG segmented control) to UI, conditionally hides quality slider for PNG, dynamic export button text. Added format validation in export handler to normalize invalid format strings. CR-09: Replaced 5 hex text spans with visual color swatch buttons (32x32px) that update reactively. Addressed world-review concerns: added aria-hidden to decorative swatches, added role=radiogroup/role=radio/aria-checked to export format segmented control, added export format validation guard. All 812 tests pass (1 pre-existing failure in SaliencyDebugOverlayTest.html unrelated).
